integrity: The endpoint proof uses exact row-sum/column-sum operator-norm identities for finite linear combinations of partial permutations and the published groupoid endpoint duality. No finite experiment is used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an inverse semigroup without zero and a Hausdorff universal groupoid, equivalently the weak-semilattice condition. It does not treat non-Hausdorff universal groupoids or contracted zero-semigroup variants.
title: The \(p=\infty\) endpoint and simultaneous-exponent reduced algebras of weak semilattices
